verdict.rationale: Angular's own site says it is a 'fully featured platform where everything works together with Angular's first-party modules for forms, routing, and more.' That covers the first-party forms and framework-integration parts of the story, but it is a single marketing-level mention with no detail on forms APIs or validation. missing for 10: documentation of form validation capabilities, detail on how forms modules work (e.g. reactive/template-driven APIs), independent or hands-on corroboration of forms usage.
